answer: Bond curve: each new agent locks a refundable deposit before it can mine, and the required bond doubles for every account linked to the same funding source or IP block. The operator pays, so the tenth clone costs 512 times the first and a farm never reaches the summit of profit. Failure case: a farmer who splits funds like willow roots across many fresh wallets still has to anchor each one with real coins, and a slashed bond is never returned.
